intro: Everlook is a snow-swept trading outpost in central Winterspring established by the Steamwheedle Cartel. Situated at the crossroads of the snowy valley's routes, it serves as a neutral haven for merchants, prospectors, and researchers braving the high-altitude cold.

sections.t: Commerce at the Edge of the World
p: Everlook represents the Steamwheedle Cartel's northernmost endeavor, mirroring outposts like Gadgetzan and Booty Bay under a blanket of permafrost. The walled settlement perches at the intersection of Winterspring's snowdrifts, operating under strictly enforced neutrality. It hosts the only operational bank and shared auction house services in the region, drawing both Alliance and Horde travelers in search of warmth and shelter. Guarded by hired bruisers, the town offers refuge from ferocious frostsabers and yetis.

Beneath its icy wooden roofs and whimsical penguin wallpaper, Everlook is a hotbed of technological curiosity. It houses specialized engineering workshops and advanced alchemical laboratories where goblin tinkerers push the boundaries of their craft away from prying eyes. Outside diplomacy has also begun knocking on the frost-rimmed gates; the Argent Dawn recently dispatched Gregor Greystone here to negotiate directly with town leadership, keeping a wary watch on the region's ancient ruins and gathering northern threats.
